verdict.rationale: Aleph documents most of the ingredients from live data: board-ready variance analysis and versioned forecasts, AI-generated variance commentary via Scan, reporting automation that keeps existing reporting packages in sync, and an agent that can build or update reports and dashboards. Nothing shows it producing an assembled board pack or slide deck as a single output, so the founder may still be compiling the pack by hand. Missing for 10: documented board-pack or slide/deck generation or export, an end-to-end workflow combining metrics, commentary and forecast into one pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing).
